classes.text: General or miscellaneous process component that is not an instrumentation symbol, flow arrow, valve, tank, pump, or off-page inlet/outlet connector.
Instrumentation symbol representing measurement or control, commonly drawn as a circular instrument bubble; use the complete original visible instrument body.
Flow direction arrow or arrowhead along a pipe or process connection, distinct from an off-page connector.
Valve component controlling a pipe or process flow, including outline and filled valve appearances.
Process equipment: tank or vessel, or pump or compressor. The reference examples show a tank and a pump.
Inlet or outlet connector indicating continuation beyond the diagram or to another sheet, distinct from a flow-direction arrow.
Another type, background, text, pipe segment, junction, crossing, or an uncertain region that cannot be assigned to the physical component categories above.
